purpose: Re-read the published ESB Earnings22 TEST subset ONCE MORE, with the ONE factor the 2026-09-07 encoding probes admitted on dev: the media. Exactly 2.0 s of digital silence appended to every one of the 2,735 published test utterances, and everything else byte-identical to the sealed SAEA-E22-ESB-SHORTFORM-ALIGNMENT-V1 flight -- same instruction, same prompt shape, same decoding params, same build, same decoder and mmproj by sha256, same raw-audio mmproj path with no packet and no feature cache, same -c 32768 -np 8 geometry, same harness and same entry point. One cell, E22-ESB-2735-TS2. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-esb-shortform-tail2s-test-v1-preregistration.md. NOT AUTHORIZED by this fragment: this is a SECOND read of a population the 2026-09-04 owner allowance permitted once, and it needs the owner's explicit GO recorded in its own exposure row before the first contact.

deviations_from_the_published_row.deviation: THE PUBLISHED SYSTEMS DID NOT APPEND SILENCE. Every request in this cell carries 2.0 s of digital silence after the published span; the 9.79 and 12.3 systems consumed the ESB release's own arrays and nothing else.
deviations_from_the_published_row.why: our serving path glues an unmasked, non-silent constant to the end of almost every clip and charges 13 audio tokens for it, while the published HF path masks that block away (2026-09-07 short-clip encoding audit). On THIS population that block is 17,695 audio tokens (6.52 % of 271,453) computed from 136,533 mel frames = 1,365.3 s of constant on 2,733 of 2,735 clips, and per clip it averages 11.53 % of what we send and reaches 76.92 % on the worst clip. The tail does not remove it -- appending 200 whole mel frames leaves the residue (n_samples // 160) % 100 unchanged, so the same 136,533 pad frames and the same 17,695 masked-away tokens are still sent and their pooled share falls only to 5.17 % (mean per-clip 11.53 % to 6.74 %, worst clip 76.92 % to 25.64 %) -- it moves the block 2.0 s away from the last word and puts the clamp floor a real stop produces between the two.
deviations_from_the_published_row.expected_effect: the whole point of the cell, and the reason its number is NOT a like-for-like reproduction of the published protocol. Every published claim built on this number must carry this deviation; see the decision block.

prediction_fixed_before_any_contact.basis: SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-TAIL2S-V1 on 1,500 dev rows: corpus Whisper-normalized WER 9.4054 against the sealed comparator's 17.4012 on the same published segments, a delta of -7.9958 points and a ratio of 0.5405.
prediction_fixed_before_any_contact.transfer_assumption: The dev and test populations are two splits of one ESB repartition at one revision, cut by the same slicer from the same locked MP3s, sent through the same instruction, the same decoding params and the same build; the encoding artifact the tail addresses is a property of the serving path, not of a call. The assumption is that the artifact's effect transfers in KIND. It is NOT assumed to transfer in SIZE. The two populations are near twins in the artifact's footprint -- mean clip 7.128 s (test) against 6.633 s (dev1500), pooled masked-away share 6.52 % against 6.99 %, mean per-clip share 11.53 % against 12.00 %, the same 76.92 % worst clip -- which supports transfer in kind and, if anything, makes the test population marginally LESS affected, so the dev delta is not a lower bound. Against that, the sealed test arm's error mass has a different shape (59.2 % insertions, hypothesis-to-reference ratio 1.0749) from the dev arm's boundary-block-dominated mass, and its own length-oracle bound was 10.456, which sits ABOVE the multiplicative prediction.
prediction_fixed_before_any_contact.predicted_direction: corpus WER falls; the insertion share and the hypothesis-to-reference length ratio fall; the effect concentrates in the short-duration buckets, which is where the encoding audit prices the artifact.
prediction_fixed_before_any_contact.falsifier_of_the_transfer: a corpus WER above 12.79 refutes the transfer assumption outright, and the verdict must say so in those words rather than reinterpreting the prediction after the fact. A number inside the preregistered interval is a confirmation; a number below 7.5 or between 10.5 and 12.79 is recorded as the prediction missing its interval while keeping its sign, and the miss is reported as prominently as the direction.

decision.owner_alignment_standard: 2026-09-04 owner directive: aligned means within 3 points of the published number, or better by more than 3; and the frozen Qwen3-Omni Q4_K_M must never score worse than a degraded model's published number on the same column.
decision.floor_test_loose: corpus Whisper-normalized WER <= 15.09 (whisper-base.en), reported either way
decision.aligned: ALIGNED = band test AND strict floor test both pass
decision.fail: NOT ALIGNED otherwise, with the failing half of the rule named and the gap decomposed per call and against D1-D5 and D-TS2-3
decision.reported_beside_it: the agentic error rate and the boundary category mass, both against the sealed arm's 2026-09-04 values, so the verdict says what MOVED and not only what the pooled number is
decision.standing_rule_this_cell_deviates_from: The 2026-09-06 array-durations verdict made the boundary claim rule UNCONDITIONAL: a number from a cell that changes the audio the protocol delivers is a statement about this study's own sensitivity, is never an alignment argument, and is never compared to 9.79 or 12.3. Applying the alignment band to this cell is a DEVIATION from that standing rule and rests on the owner decision recorded in this cell's exposure row, not on this fragment.
decision.claim_surface: This number is an alignment figure for THIS STUDY'S SHORT-FORM SURFACE UNDER A NAMED MODEL-USAGE LOCAL OPTIMIZATION. It is not a reproduction of the published protocol and must never be reported as one: the published systems did not append silence (D-TS2-3), and every statement of this number must carry that sentence. What makes the optimization legitimate rather than a thumb on the scale is that it adds no information -- the tail is digital silence after the published span, every published sample is delivered unaltered and in order, nothing is removed -- and that it addresses a defect of OUR serving path which the published path does not have: mtmd_audio_preprocessor_qwen3a glues up to 0.99 s of unmasked, non-silent 0.0 constant to the end of the clip and charges 13 audio tokens for it, where the HF Qwen3OmniMoeProcessor masks that block away. The honest reading is that the tail moves our input processing CLOSER IN EFFECT to the published path's, not that it makes the two identical.
decision.what_this_cell_cannot_conclude: That the residual gap is quantization, or prompt, or decode. That the tail is the only remaining difference: the 2026-09-06 array-durations check recorded a second live deviation this cell does not address -- the release stores each call's native container (16 kHz stereo, 22.05 kHz stereo, 24 kHz mono) while this study's clips are librosa-decoded 16 kHz mono from the locked MP3s. Nothing about the other 109 confirmatory calls. Nothing about generalization, superiority or Stage-3.
decision.not_authorized: No mechanism arm. No read of the other 109 confirmatory calls. No ESB validation-split read. No THIRD read of these six calls. No Q8_0 composition. No frame-exact or pad-30s variant on test. No post-processing of any hypothesis. No re-scoring of any sealed arm. No merge_compounds. No packet or feature-cache path. No knob tuned on this population, before or after. No paper-scale-confirmatory profile, no manuscript, no submission, no Stage-3 activity.
